coverage.description: exec stages per-entity ordered deltas in a BTreeMap transaction, creates one state per nonempty transaction entry in ID order, with latest+1 version and shared cause/note metadata. Cursor and events append directly to the temporary world. Loc/Obj/Char create attributes and inverse containment links; Cursor inherits omitted at/time. Move updates both containment sides; Have deliberately leaves the old side for post-link rejection; Give requires current holder, distinct recipient and nearness. Set rejects At, wrong keys and silent known-value changes, with v3 repeated-death identity checks. Rel creates/updates endpoints and fact sets, leaving obsolete links for validation. Event/Say capture participant versions and metadata. Plan/Believe maintain owner links and stage transitions; Done/Unset clear known fields with causes. Feel changes a tag collection under continuity/silent-change guards. Detach/Attach rewrite part/whole and containment links with nearness and real-cause checks. Mention only contributes touched IDs. Narrative-only commands return Frame here. Before flushing deltas, a cause's world/branch must match this world.
